gloss: from now; from this point on; hereafter

definitions.gloss: from now; from this point on; hereafter
definitions.explanation: A formal expression indicating the start of something or marking the transition to what comes next. Used to signal that an event, announcement, or action is about to begin.

definitions.gloss: beyond this point; from here onward
definitions.explanation: Indicates a spatial boundary, marking the area or territory that lies beyond the current position.

examples.japanese: これより⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めます→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: We will now begin the meeting.

examples.japanese: これより{式|しき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{執|と}り{行|おこな}います→執り行う：19902_toriokonau⟧。

これより⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{議事録|ぎじろく}→議事録：07482_gijiroku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦されます→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、ご⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be advised that all statements from this point on will be recorded in the minutes.

examples.japanese: これより⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧、⟦{立入禁止|たちいりきんし}→立入禁止：09542_tachiirikinshi⟧。
これより⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雪国|ゆきぐに}→雪国：14608_yukiguni⟧だ。
examples.english: North of here is snow country.

examples.japanese: これより⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{登山|とざん}{道|どう}→登山道：19132_tozandou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{険|けわ}しく→険しい：08154_kewashii⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{装備|そうび}→装備：14103_soubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The mountain trail becomes steep beyond this point, so please check your equipment.

notes:
A formal, somewhat literary expression composed of ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧ (this) + ⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧ (from). Common in official announcements, ceremonies, signage, and formal writing. In everyday speech, the equivalent would be ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from now) for time or ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from here) for space.

REGISTER:
Formal. Used in ceremonies, official proceedings, signs, and literary contexts. Rarely heard in casual conversation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- これより⟦{始|はじ}めます→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧: we will now begin
- これより⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: beyond this point (temporal or spatial)
- これより⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧: after this

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from now — the everyday equivalent for temporal use
- ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from here — the everyday equivalent for spatial use
- ⟦{以後|いご}→以後：01710_igo⟧: hereafter; from now on — formal, emphasizes ongoing applicability
- ⟦{今後|こんご}→今後：02808_kongo⟧: from now on; henceforth — formal, forward-looking
